Which statement about alkenes is correct?
A
Alkenes are saturated molecules containing a C=C double bond.
B
Alkenes are hydrocarbons with the general formula CnH2n+2.
C
Alkenes react with aqueous bromine to give a colour change from brown to colourless.
D
Alkenes are manufactured from larger alkene molecules in a process called combustion.

options.label: A
options.text: Alkenes are saturated molecules containing a C=C double bond.

options.label: B
options.text: Alkenes are hydrocarbons with the general formula CnH2n+2.

options.label: C
